policy: Suggestions are PROPOSALS ONLY. Nothing here is implemented until a reviewer picks a path and records the choice on this page. Each suggestion names the missing information it would discover, because decisions below (data/decisions.json) are blocked on exactly those gaps.

suggestions.title: Adopt a weekly injury-report capture protocol (same transcription method every week, same cutoff)
suggestions.rationale: The replacement-depth tracker currently runs on one verbatim capture of the official report (2026-11-13). A fixed weekly protocol (capture Wednesday+Sunday, store verbatim, re-run the depth computation) turns this from a snapshot into a signal feed.
suggestions.discovers: Current-week availability for every team, every week — the input the origination model lacks (DEC-M1).

suggestions.title: Procure a verifiable player-prop results source BEFORE implementing any prop-combo strategy
suggestions.rationale: STRAT-PROP-COMBO exists only as a blocked registry row: no official or verified source of player-prop lines/results exists in this repo, so legs cannot be graded and correlations cannot be computed. Building the strategy first would guarantee un gradeable claims.
suggestions.discovers: Prop leg results (needed for DEC-M4 correlation caps and for grading prop combos at all).

suggestions.title: Make nfl-markets the price-snapshot store of record; nfl-ledger keeps the schema
suggestions.rationale: This session populated a snapshot store with 12,573 rows (fair/open/close/diff per market per game). nfl-ledger's store is schema-complete but intentionally empty (its F-L1). Choosing one store of record prevents divergence.
suggestions.discovers: A single canonical source for 'what did we originate and what did the market do' — prerequisite for any future promotion decision (DEC-M1).

suggestions.title: Capture opening numbers WITH timestamps every week going forward
suggestions.rationale: 2022-2026 opening numbers are UNVERIFIED-BLANK because no archive publishes them with capture times. From the next slate onward, the origination snapshot (our fair line + the market's posted line + timestamp) can be captured at origination time, ending the blank-open problem permanently.
suggestions.discovers: True opening numbers with times — the missing half of the price-snapshot store (FLAG-M2).

suggestions.title: Extend depth-chart coverage to all 32 teams (labelled THIRD-PARTY) or find an official depth source
suggestions.rationale: Replacement depth is computable for 8 of 32 teams only (ESPN/RotoWire captures). 24 teams stay blank and flagged. Either ingest the remaining charts under the same THIRD-PARTY label, or locate an official source if one exists.
suggestions.discovers: Replacement depth for 24 uncovered teams (DEC-M1 injury integration, FLAG-M6).

suggestions.title: Weekly re-verification cadence: reconcile standings 32/32 and re-run the sign-convention tests after every week
suggestions.rationale: The results feed's verification rests on the 32/32 standings reconciliation plus live spot checks. Running both checks weekly catches any upstream drift in the mirror before it can corrupt the feed or the backtests.
suggestions.discovers: Continuous assurance that the feed still matches official numbers (DM-4 depends on it).

suggestions.title: Pre-register the backup/deficiency signal before next week's slate (no post-hoc fitting)
suggestions.rationale: The depth tracker quantifies replacement depth (2nd/3rd/4th/none). nfl-arena's SIG-06 explicitly requires pre-registration before use. Registering the rule (e.g., 'fade teams whose QB1 is out and replacement depth >= 2') BEFORE results accumulate is what separates signal discovery from curve-fitting.
suggestions.discovers: Whether injury-adjusted origination adds line value vs the market (the question DEC-M1 needs answered).

suggestions.title: Improve the site's decision ergonomics: one decision dashboard that merges gates, leaderboard and open questions
suggestions.rationale: The information needed for a decision is spread across leaderboard, gates, correlations and questions pages. A single dashboard page (status quo -> what would change it -> which suggestion unblocks it) reduces the chance a decision is made on a lucky staking run.
suggestions.discovers: Nothing new — it surfaces what exists; it exists to prevent decisions being made from the wrong page.
